_about: Shadow of War teardown (mhvnsnt/teardown-shadow-of-war, N1) — the rival trait SCHEMA for the living-world rivalry module (src/lib/rivalry.ts). Trait classes follow the documented Nemesis structure at systems level only: immunities (what a rival cannot be hurt by), hates (what enrages/empowers it), fears (what breaks its nerve). No Monolith expressive material, trait text, names or dialogue transfer — this is Mochiichao's own schema in Mochiichao vocabulary. typeRef values are battle type ids in Mochiichao's own type vocabulary. Ships schema-only: trait ROWS keyed to canon factions/areas are owner/canon content and are authored with the living-world content, never invented by the wiring.

entryShape.note: string, optional authoring note — never player-facing trait text by itself
entryShape.typeRef: string, a Mochiichao battle type id or effect class

traitClasses.fears: typeRefs, conditions or actor classes that can break the rival's nerve
traitClasses.hates: typeRefs, conditions or actor classes whose presence enrages the rival
traitClasses.immunities: typeRefs or effect classes the rival is immune to
